{{Quote|The Army of the Dead. Our reinforcements.|[[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]|<ref name="Massacre">{{TCW|Massacre}}</ref>}}
The '''Army of the Dead''', also called the '''Undead Army''' or '''Nightsister zombies''', were made up of undead [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Zombie/Legends|zombies]] that participated in a fight to hold back a [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] invasion.

==History==
[[File:Undead_Nightsister.jpg|thumb|left|225px|An Undead Nightsister.]]
The army was summoned by [[Daka/Legends|Old Daka]], who was among the wisest of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]], by using a resurrection spell that spread in to a Nightsister graveyard and opened the cocoons that held the undead warriors. The army helped [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Ventress]] and the rest of the Dathomirians to destroy the droid invasion and prevent them from getting to [[Nightsister fortress|Talzin's village]]. Most of the army engaged the enemy without any weapons of some sort except their arms and legs, defeating many droids, but they were no match for Grievous.

The army perished when [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] assaulted and captured the village and destroyed the entrance of the [[Hidden Cave/Legends|hidden cave]] in which [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] and Old Daka had summoned the ferocious warriors. Grievous executed Old Daka with a [[Shiak|stab]] through the witch's stomach, resulting in the destruction of all the warriors of the dead army and leaving the Nightsisters to be greatly outnumbered and executed.
